## Modine Names New Presidents for Data Centers, Commercial HVAC Segments


November 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/270741342/files/doc_news/2026/Modine-Names-New-Presidents-for-Data-Centers-Commercial-HVAC-Segments.pdf)


RACINE, Wis.


, Nov. 5, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Modine, a diversified global leader in thermal management technology and solutions, today announced key executive leadership appointments. Effective November 2, Michael Mahan has been appointed President, Data Centers segment. Concurrently, David Furlong is promoted to President, Commercial HVAC (CHVAC), effective November 15.


"I am pleased to announce the appointments of Michael and Dave to lead these pivotal segments," said Neil D. Brinker, President and Chief Executive Officer. "Both leaders are uniquely suited to their new roles and possess a deep familiarity with our corporate growth objectives and 80/20 operating model. Their combined expertise in transforming businesses and driving operational discipline will ensure we continue to capitalize on the opportunities for our advanced thermal management technologies, delivering value for customers and shareholders."


Michael Mahan joined the company earlier this year to lead the CHVAC segment, bringing more than 20 years of global leadership experience, including large P&L management roles at Crane Payment Innovations, Schneider Electric, and former GE companies. As President of Crane Payment Innovations, he successfully aligned multiple commercial business units into fully formed P&Ls with end-to-end business ownership. At Schneider Electric, Mahan led multi-billion-dollar global businesses, successfully defining strategic plans to focus on emerging opportunities, including those in data center markets.


Dave Furlong joined the company in 2023, overseeing global corporate strategy, business optimization and development, mergers and acquisitions, and divestitures. Under his leadership, the company successfully acquired six companies in two years and divested underperforming assets. In 2025, Furlong served as interim president for the Performance Technologies segment and, for the past year, has led the complex work to spinoff that segment. His extensive experience prior to joining the company includes global leadership roles across sales, marketing, engineering, and product development at Quadion LLC, IDEX, and Pentair.


**About Modine**
For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 9,000 employees worldwide, our businesses advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, Europe, and Asia.
